youtube.title: Ada Lovelace's massive flex on Charles Babbage 💻 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Ada Lovelace, the first computer programmer, was only asked to translate one article. 💅💻

Her "notes" came out 3x longer than the article... and had the first computer program in them.

Would you rather be Ada or Babbage? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on 1843: Ada translated Menabrea's paper on Babbage's Analytical Engine, added Notes A–G (Note G = an algorithm for Bernoulli numbers), and the engine was never built.

#adalovelace #charlesbabbage #firstcomputerprogrammer #computerhistory #analyticalengine #historymemes #shorts

hook.say: She was asked to translate one paper. She added three times more notes. And invented coding.
